meta.title: Roleplay chat
meta.description: A lightweight roleplay chat with freely configurable character cards — install and play. Three dialogue lengths, a one-tap tension boost, automatic memory and a character status bar. Memory, conversations and character cards are all kept in the browser's local storage: nothing is written to disk, and switching browsers or clearing browser data wipes them. Pair with the Multi-character story add-on to let several characters interact together.
